final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS avg_hgb_hct FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb_hct) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT a.ID, a.SEX, a.avg_wbc, a.avg_hgb_hct, a.avg_hgb_hct - o.avg_ratio AS difference FROM patient_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_hgb_hct > o.avg_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
